title: SmartRoute Telemetry Correlator: deterministic sampling and causal enrichment for cross-region fallbacks
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: Our current routing telemetry emits full per-hop decision payloads for sampled requests. This provides high fidelity but is expensive in storage, indexing, and query cost, and it does not reliably tie together multi-hop cross-region fallback sequences when sampling is stochastic. Goal: introduce a lightweight Telemetry Correlator that produces deterministic sampling and causal enrichment so that chains of route decisions (region selection, tier routing, fallback model variant) are reconstructable, compact, and easy to query without increasing storage costs significantly. Success metrics: 90% reconstruction rate for multi-hop fallbacks in sampled traces, <=25% increase in ingestion volume vs existing sampled baseline, ability to answer lineage queries ("what sequence of variants ran for this customer request") in <2s for 95th percentile.
acceptance_criteria: Agent emits route_lineage_v2 envelope for sampled requests and for sampled hops within deterministic set
Deterministic sampler implemented: hashing(request_id, route_fingerprint, customer_bucket) with adjustable sampling_ratio and stable salt
Per-hop metrics encoded as delta frames to reduce size by >=40% vs full JSON payload for sampled traces
Console: new Trace view can render correlated multi-hop waterfall and list fallback variants with latency and cost per hop
Query support: lineage queries return ordered hop list with model variant and region in <2s for 95th percentile on our observability cluster
decision_log: Chose deterministic hashing-based sampling over probabilistic sampling to ensure that related hops (same request across retries/fallbacks) are either all sampled or all skipped — reduces partial traces and simplifies reconstruction.
Pack per-hop metrics into a compact delta frame (timestamp_delta, token_delta, cpu_ms_delta) instead of repeating full fields; trade-off is slightly more complex ingestion but large storage savings.
Introduce a lightweight causal token (lineage_id + hop_idx + parent_hop_id optional) instead of duplicating full context; keeps logs queryable without exposing full prompt contents.
Opted for log-compression at producer side (snappy + base64) and schema v2 envelope to avoid immediate pipeline changes downstream.
Decision to require security review because lineage_id maps requests across regions and could be used for correlation with user ids in downstream dashboards; will apply PII gating in ingestion stage.
updates: 2026-02-20: Spike completed comparing deterministic sampler implementations (modulo hash, murmur3) — murmur3 produced better distribution for low-entropy request ids; initial implementation uses murmur3 with 64-bit salt.
2026-02-25: Design doc posted: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INF/SmartRoute+Telemetry+Correlator (internal) — contains schema v2 draft and producer-side compression plan.

2026-03-02: Prototype correlator service implemented in platform/producers; generates lineage_id and hop_idx and emits route_lineage_v2 envelope. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4872
2026-03-05: Benchmarked ingestion: correlated traces produce 0.9x storage compared to current sampled baseline using 5% deterministic sampling; compression saves ~48% per sampled trace.
2026-03-08: Security review kickoff with Compliance (Priya Rao) — flagged need to scrub any raw prompt fragments from lineage envelope and add KMS access controls for lineage lookup APIs.
2026-03-10: UX mock for Console trace view approved by product (Ethan Brooks) — mock includes waterfall with expandable hop details and variant timelines.
implementation_notes: Producer changes: add small library to emit lineage_id (64-bit) + hop_idx; encode per-hop metrics as delta frame; compress envelope with snappy before sending to ingestion.
Ingestion changes: accept route_lineage_v2, decode snappy, validate lineage_id deterministic property, persist compact frames to lineage_index table (TTL 90d configurable).
Query layer: add lineage aggregator that reconstructs hop chain from compact frames and returns JSON suitable for console display; index lineage_id + last_hop_timestamp for fast lookup.
Backwards compatibility: consumers that cannot parse v2 will see a fallback metadata flag; keep v1 logs for 14 days before gradual archive retirement.
Config: expose sampling_ratio and salt via runtime config (ConfigService) with rollout toggle for canary by customer org id.
Telemetry retention/cost: initial plan 90d full retention for lineage_index and 365d archived compressed blobs in cold storage for audits.
qa_plan: Unit tests for hashing determinism and sample ratio boundaries
Integration test: simulate multi-hop fallback (region A -> region B -> model variant C) and assert single lineage_id across hops and full reconstruction
Load test: validate ingestion at projected 2x peak sampling rate without >5% increase in processing latency
Security test: ensure lineage envelope contains no prompt text and PII sighting tests pass
E2E console test: open trace view for canary customer and verify hop waterfall and metrics appear and align with raw logs
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): 5% of traffic from internal orgs — enable deterministic sampling with salt A and sample_ratio 0.05 — monitor reconstruction rate and storage delta (2 weeks)
Phase 2 (org canaries): enable for 10 pilot customers with high fallback incidence — gather feedback from support/SE (2 weeks)
Phase 3 (regional ramp): ramp sampling to 10-20% across US regions, maintain <25% ingestion delta; enable lineage_index retention policy
Phase 4 (full): 100% producer rollout with default sample_ratio=0.05 and ability to tune per-customer via Console
Rollback: toggle sampling_ratio=0 and revert producer library version via canary tags if we observe >10% increase in ingestion latency or PII incidents
open_risks: False positives for reconstruction if request_id is not stable across retries — mitigated by pairing request_id with route_fingerprint and customer_bucket
Index explosion if many customers opt into higher sampling_ratio — plan to rate-limit per-customer lineage retention and expose cost controls
Query performance at scale: lineage_index must be sharded by lineage_id and time; early benchmarking required to prevent >2s query latency
Compliance: lineage_id could be used to correlate activity across datasets; need DPO signoff on retention and access controls
